description: This file defines a repository class for booking seat data, including methods to retrieve booking seat information by reference UID, with detailed nested related data such as booking details, attendees, user, and event type.

classes.name: BookingSeatRepository
classes.description: Repository class for accessing booking seat data from the database.

methods.name: getByReferenceUid
methods.description: Retrieves a booking seat by its reference UID, including basic booking info.

methods.name: getByReferenceUidIncludeBookingWithAttendeesAndUserAndEvent
methods.description: Retrieves detailed booking seat info by reference UID, including nested booking, attendees, user, and event type data.
